gen-gf-autour-one-gf-ubuntu-sans: Round and loud, Autour One takes the stage. Ubuntu Sans follows with big-eyed lowercase and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, a friendly counterweight to all that display swagger.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-sofia-sans-semi: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed reads tight and tidy, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. But Funnel Display brings spaghetti-like, same-width strokes that feel expressive and commanding beside it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-aldrich: Distinctive and tall, Gugi nearly lifts its lowercase to cap height. Aldrich then reads like tracing one thick thread, with cupped round letters that move smoothly down the line.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-armata: Tall, open-mouthed letters lead, courtesy of Gugi. Armata follows with spacious gaps between characters and lowercase that fills most of the letter height, so both fonts feel generous.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mon: Distinctive Gugi stands tall, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono takes a different tack, with open counters that breathe into the white space and spacing stretched wide.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-chivo: Distinctive in every stroke, Gugi stands tall and makes the entrance. Chivo does the quiet work, packing its lowercase toward the caps and leaving daylight in every curved opening.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-chocolate-classical-sans: Rounded-rod, single-weight and tall, Gugi is hard to miss. Chocolate Classical Sans writes with a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut, and its sizable lowercase keeps things easygoing.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-comme: Distinctive Gugi stands tall, with no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. And Comme reads smoothly beside it, with no clogged curves and lowercase filling most of the letter height.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-cossette-texte: Bold in build, Gugi runs its lowercase nearly up to cap height. Cossette Texte brings a wide-eyed lowercase e, sturdy n arches and a prominent x-height for a clean, easy counterpart.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-funnel-sans: Tall and open-ended, Gugi lifts its lowercase nearly to cap height and cuts its terminals open so the counters flow outward. Funnel Sans holds its strokes level; Gugi earns its keep big and short.
